description: We are a team of AI & Machine Learning Engineers specializing in Python, LLMs, and RAG pipelines. For the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, we are building an interactive AI chatbot to tell the stories of discarded NASA equipment on the Moon and Mars. We are currently just bringing our existing friends onto the roster to finalize our team structure and execute the MVP before the deadline!
summary: SPACE AFTERLIFE is an interactive educational website that tells the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It brings forgotten spacecraft, rovers, and scientific instruments back into the spotlight through storytelling, timelines, and interactive quizzes
details:
Every Mission Leaves a Story Behind.

SPACE AFTERLIFE is an interactive educational storytelling website that explores the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Instead of treating retired spacecraft, scientific instruments, and exploration vehicles as forgotten objects, the project presents them as important parts of humanity's space exploration history.

The website features seven mission and equipment stories, including Apollo Lunar Module descent stages, Lunar Roving Vehicles, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Viking 1, and the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP). Users can explore equipment stories, follow historical mission timelines, read educational chapters, and test their knowledge through an interactive quiz.

The project uses NASA mission information and the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA) to support its storytelling and provide source references. SPACE AFTERLIFE aims to make space exploration history more accessible, engaging, and memorable by showing that even when a mission ends, its legacy remains.
